programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: The journey leads through one of the most fascinating delta landscapes in the world. Starting in the untouched jungle of the Tumucumaque in the north of the Amazon delta, the journey continues south by boat across the 30 kilometre wide river to the Ilha de Maraj. The largest river island in the world, as large as Switzerland, is surrounded by wide beaches, mangrove forests and floodplain forests. On the island untouched jungle and wet savannah characterise the land. Fishermen and aai farmers live from the fruits of nature on the edge of the numerous river veins and flood plains and the collection of medicinal plants serves here, far away from civilization, as a living for the people. On the south side of the delta in the city of Belem we explore the exotic world of the famous Ver-o-Peso market with its impressive variety of fish, tropical fruits, spices and medicinal herbs.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Irrawaddy Delta: The Magical World of Mangroves
programme.desc: The Irrawaddy Delta in southern Myanmar is home to the most diverse mangrove forests in the world. The forests serve as natural protection against cyclones that regularly strike the region. The Irrawaddy's widely branching tributaries not only provide schools of fish and rich nutrients, but also function as the most important transport route for the people living in the delta. The greengrocer couple U Tin Hlaing and Daw Khin Lay supply the villages downstream with their fresh produce. But they do not go any further than the Meinmahla Kyun Wildlife Sanctuary. From that point on, the river becomes increasingly turbulent, too dangerous for their small, flat boat. The sanctuary is home to a variety of animal species including the rare Irrawaddy dolphins, saltwater crocodiles, birds of prey such as black kites and brahminy kites, migratory birds such as spoon-billed sandpipers, woodcocks, great cormorants and various anatids. Ranger Lha Soe Win and his colleagues regularly patrol the nature reserve to monitor the animal population and make sure the mangroves are no longer illegally logged for firewood. Since the 1970s, the mangrove population has declined by more than 60 percent, with dramatic consequences for the inhabitants of the delta. Cyclone Nargis, the most devastating cyclone to date, claimed the lives of around 130,000 Burmese in 2008. Together with scientists from the conservation charity Flora and Fauna International, the rangers are working on reforesting the mangroves to restore their function as a natural barrier in the future.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programme.desc: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programme.desc: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programme.desc: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In August 1972, the body of Jody Loomis is found in the woods. 34 years later, the killer's DNA is recovered from Jody's old clothing but it isn't matched until 2018.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In Wisconsin, advances in forensic clay modeling help investigators identify a murder victim whose skin was stripped from her head, neck, and legs. And in California, police track down two boys who enjoy satanic rituals and setting fires.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: Firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide. A serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Law enforcement officials fear they may have to release a serial killer from prison until a 24-year-old murder case gives them a chance to lock him up for good.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Police in Overland Park, Kansas, hunt for over 15 years for a serial killer who lures women to Kansas for sadomasochistic sexual trysts at hotels.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In July of 1970, the brutal murder of single mom Loretta Jones leaves four-year-old Heidi motherless. Nearly 40 years later, she vows to solve her mother's cold case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: The murder of a 73-year-old man leads police on a long chase for a man who's suspected of identity theft and bears a rose tattoo with the name "Phyllis".

Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Todo lo que brilla no es oro
programme.desc: La policía descubre un carro agujereado de balas, un conductor extraviado y ningún testigo. ¿Será que la víctima fue raptada o ha sido asesinada?

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Noticia de última hora
programme.desc: Una joven productora de noticias de televisión es violada y asesinada en su apartamento. La policía identifica a dos sospechosos, pero ambos son absueltos de cualquier delito.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1990, el cuerpo de Shirley Andronowich fue encontrado mutilado. Los testigos le dijeron a la policía que tuvo una pelea con su esposo la noche anterior, pero la evidencia forense demostró que él no tuvo nada que ver con su muerte.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Raspando la Superficie
programme.desc: Los científicos forenses trabajan con la única pista recuperada de un tiroteo con múltiples víctimas: una escopeta de calibre 12. Los científicos utilizan métodos únicos para extraer el número de serie del arma y rastrearlo hasta su propietario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Fuego Plástico
programme.desc: Sheila Bryan, quien fue condenada por matar a su madre en el incendio de un carro, recibe un nuevo juicio. La opinión de un testigo experto en incendios sobre cómo se encendió el fuego difiere de la teoría de la fiscalía.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1997, se encontró el carro de Kelly Eckart, con todas sus pertenencias aún dentro del mismo, después de haber trabajado un turno nocturno en Franklin, Indiana. Días más tarde, se encontró su cuerpo en un barranco aislado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La mejora digital del video de la cámara de seguridad muestra que lo que parece ser un encuentro casual es en realidad un secuestro forzado, que conduce al asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Muere un atleta de secundaria, luego de que lo atropellaran y se dieran a la fuga. Todos en el pueblo lamentaron su muerte. Encontrar al asesino era muy poco probable.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En la escena de un asesinato horrible, el asesino se esforzó mucho para poder borrar sus huellas dactilares y oscurecer las huellas de zapatos que dejó cuando arrastraba los rastros de sangre en el piso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asistente del gerente de una carnicería de Florida es apuñalado hasta la muerte. Parece ser un robo que salió mal, pero una huella sangrienta revela que él conocía a su asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Genes delatores
programme.desc: Un perfil de comportamiento hizo que el Departamento de Policía de Baton Rouge buscara al hombre equivocado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La investigación de un saco de dormir desechado, que contiene zapatillas de deporte ensangrentadas y un bolso, lleva a la policía al cuerpo de una mujer joven.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un barco camaronero de dos hombres se hundió cuando una violenta tormenta de rápido movimiento azotó la costa de Luisiana. El capitán se ahogó y el marinero fue rescatado catorce horas después.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Nicole Rae Walker, de 6 años de edad, murió en un choque donde el culpable se dio a la fuga en su Vecindario de Ft. Lauderdale.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerto al cirujano cardíaco Darryl Sutorius en el sótano de su lujosa casa de Cincinnati, la policía asume que se suicidó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Después de que aparecen 10 cuerpos en Florida, una víctima – Lisa McVey de 17 años de edad – es secuestrada pero liberada. Ella lleva a la policía al autor del crimen, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las mujeres en una ciudad de Louisiana viven con el temor de un violador que no deja pistas sobre su identidad. Pero la tecnología y la ciencia del comportamiento se combinan para brindar a la policía una nueva herramienta forense.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Firme aquí
programme.desc: Una madre de dos hijos desaparece después de salir de compras. Su cuerpo es encontrado un mes después.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: El mal pie
programme.desc: La policía estaba desconcertada por una huella oscura encontrada en la escena del crimen donde un hombre había sido asesinado y dos adolescentes resultaron gravemente heridas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1987, la muerte de Crystal Purcell fue considerada un accidente. Luego en el 2001, Barbara Purcell llamó a la policía para sugerir que su desaparecido esposo había matado a Crystal.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1994, un cráneo humano recuperado de un estanque de Ohio revela un crimen espantoso. Las marcas en el cráneo indican que la víctima había sido apuñalada varias veces y que los dientes se le habían extraído con unos alicates de punta delgada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Por lo general, es fácil determinar cómo un criminal entró en la escena del crimen. Pero en este caso, estaba lejos de esclarecerse. Parecía que el asesino se desvaneció y quizá lo hizo.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and crew are called in after high roller Tony Braun, a known drug addict, is found dead in his house by a gardener.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The entire CSI team investigates a disappearance at a local university.

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When the class clown at the local high school is found murdered, the CSI team is called to investigate.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom, Sara and Warrick are called in to investigate an abandoned, blood-splattered apartment and Nick and Catherine must examine a dead scuba diver lodged in a tree.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a murder suspect who is caught red-handed, burying the victims, while Catherine and Warrick take on the case of a woman found dead in a hotel spa.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and Nick investigate the death of a book restorer, while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a fatal train crash.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and Catherine investigate the apparent violent death of a woman found in a sandbox. Their investigation leads them to the underground world of s and m clubs.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a casino heist during which innocent victims were shot, while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a murder in a remote part of the desert.

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The CSI team is called in when a famous real estate entrepreneur is found dead in a hotel elevator.

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI

programme.desc: Catherine is ordered by a kidnapper to accompany a man who is to deliver $1 million in ransom to him or else he will kill the man's mistress.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Dos amorosos estudiantes de primer año son encontrados muertos en un saco de dormir en un dormitorio, y Sara y Greg se topan con un callejón sin salida tras otro mientras intentan determinar por qué fueron asesinados los estudiantes.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Senseless Slayings
programme.desc: When a person places no value on human life, they can become unstoppable in their twisted missions to destroy the lives around them. These women all pushed boundaries, and shattered lives with their actions.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Twisted Thrills
programme.desc: The intimate thoughts of a twisted mind would be enough to stun a community and horrify the world. But thoughts alone may not be enough to turn someone into a killer. This is a bizarre journey into the world of women who kill for twisted thrills.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Loathe Thy Neighbor
programme.desc: Neighbors can be a source of friendship and community comfort. But what happens when a neighbor stops watching out for you, and starts watching you. The sinister minds of these women begin to turn sour and they begin to torment their neighbors.

programme.title: Deadly Women: An Inconvenient Marriage
programme.desc: Love is a powerful emotion; it can drive women to unthinkable crimes of passion. Hate however, is love's gloomy shadow, and it can drive women into the darkest corners of their mind.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sins of the Sister
programme.desc: A sisterly bond can mean a life full of friendship and sibling love. But for some women, having a sister means nothing more then having their own personal meal ticket, scapegoat and combatant. These types of relationships can lead to deadly outcomes.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Kill For Cash
programme.desc: Money is a strong motivator. It can be used for good. It can be used for evil. It can be the driving force behind murder. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Van He'llsing
programme.desc: When Missy and Jase's son Reed purchases an old van to boost his music career, his parents begin to question some of his choices. Meanwhile, Willie helps Jep prepare River for a competitive wrestling league by introducing him to his friend.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Toad to Perdition
programme.desc: When Willie and his brothers spend too much time frog hunting, their wives challenge them to a "frogging" competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: RV There Yet?
programme.desc: The Robertson family takes a road trip to Liberty University where they will drop off John Luke and Mary Kate for their first year of college. Along the way, they stop in Nashville to visit Willie's friend Colt Ford.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie & Korie's Anniversorry
programme.desc: The Robertson family throws a party for Willie & Korie's 25th anniversary, but things take a dramatic turn when Willie and Korie reveal a big secret. Meanwhile, when Jase blames Uncle Si for getting him a parking ticket.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Statue of Imitations
programme.desc: When Willie asks a local chainsaw artist to make him a statue, he gets a big surprise when it's revealed that the statue is of an unlikely subject - Willie himself. Meanwhile, Jep and Jessica attempt to help Kay with her hoarding.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A Decent Proposal
programme.desc: On a trip to New York, Jase's son Reed proposes to his girlfriend, which inspires his father to fan the flames of romance back home with Missy. Meanwhile, Sadie asks Willie to be a guest lecturer at her business class.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Father Knows Pest
programme.desc: The tables are turned when the HOA comes to Jase for help to rid the neighborhood of a menacing beaver. Little Will has just gotten his learner's permit, and Willie and Si argue over which of them is the better driving instructor.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Wild Wild West Monroe
programme.desc: When Jase and Jep get into an argument over which of them is the rightful heir to their grandfather's old rifle, they decide to settle the argument with a marksmanship contest. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie help Rebecca prepare for her trip to Taiwan.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Half in the Bag
programme.desc: After Si has started moonlighting as a grocery bagger, the guys show up at the store and their teasing inadvertently causes Si to lose his job and his chance to enter a local bagging competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: There Will Be Flood
programme.desc: When a large storm hits Monroe, most of the adults head to Phil and Kay's to help protect their house from flooding while Jess, Sadie, Rebecca and Cole babysit the kids. Meanwhile, Jep, Si, Martin and Godwin try to protect the Duck Commander.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bingo Star
programme.desc: Willie accompanies Kay to a local bingo tournament and gets seduced by the game, eventually embarrassing himself and Kay with his enthusiasm.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sadie's Choice
programme.desc: Willie takes Sadie on a tour of a local college in hopes of convincing her to stay nearby after her impending high school graduation.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Children of the Cornbread
programme.desc: When the Robertson brothers debate which of their wives makes the best cornbread, it escalates into a full-on cornbread cook off. Meanwhile, when Jep, Martin, and Godwin play a practical joke on Uncle Si, it ends up being Si who has the last laugh.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Whole Lotta Bull
programme.desc: The guys enjoy a one-day rodeo fantasy camp where they learn the ins and outs of riding, roping and clowning.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Comes the Son
programme.desc: After leaving school to pursue music, Jase feels that Reed needs some structure in his life, so he hires him to take his place at Duck Commander.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bro'd Trip
programme.desc: Jase accompanies Willie on a business trip to Arkansas to pitch a new product and has unorthodox sales strategies. Back in Monroe, Jep and Si have to track down an important item of Willie's that they accidentally shipped out.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Willie thinks his kids have been spending too much time on their phones and other devices so he initiates a "No-Tech Week," but when he has to participate too it ends up being harder than he thought. There's a lice outbreak at Duck Command.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The West Monroe Wing
programme.desc: Willie and Jase run against each other to become president of their neighborhood HOA. Jep, Jess and Miss Kay work on a Duck Commander themed display for the local zoo.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Automation Frustration
programme.desc: Willie buys a 3D printer for the office that starts off as a fun distraction for the guys until it appears the printer could soon replace their jobs. Si is upset that Willie invested in the 3D printer and didn't give him a raise.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Razing the Snakes
programme.desc: Jase, Jep, Si and Cole try to fight back a growing population of cottonmouth snakes on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Willie uses his business expertise to help Rebecca improve her clothing store.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Uneasy Rider
programme.desc: Willie puts Little Will on a budget for his first car but it backfires when Will decides to get a motorcycle instead. Jase and the guys are inspired to design a product using zip lines that will revolutionize duck hunting.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Willie Hunting
programme.desc: While many of the guys' wives and children are in Africa doing charity work, Willie and Jase get into a debate over tracking ability which leads to a challenge--can Jase and Si track and capture Willie and Jep?

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sleep Cover
programme.desc: With Korie still in Africa, Willie and Jep must step in and supervise Bella's sleepover. When a couple boys play a prank on the girls, Willie and Jep prove to be the perfect chaperones for the task.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drive-In Revivin'
programme.desc: Korie challenges Willie to come up with a romantic gesture without spending any money. Missy and Jase compete to see who can find a girlfriend for Mountain Man.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fishful Thinking
programme.desc: Jase's hopes to win the inaugural Duck Commander Fishing Tournament is buoyed when he is able to enlist the help of legendary angler Bill Dance. Meanwhile, Willie's vanity over his greying beard leads him to make a questionable decision.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: When Doves Fry
programme.desc: Jase and Jep make a deal with Mia and Merritt to get them to go dove hunting with them. Si tries to make some extra cash by starting a West Monroe tour.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Carpnado
programme.desc: Jumping Asian carp have invaded Monroe's waters so Jase and the guys set out to try to stop them from spreading further. Meanwhile, Willie and Si have to run Willie's Duck Diner for the day.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Campfire Diaries
programme.desc: The family spends a weekend at their childhood summer camp, reliving old memories and working to repair a tennis court Willie built twenty years ago. While at the camp, Jep tries to pass a lifeguard swimming test he failed as a teenager.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Rowdy's Big Day
programme.desc: Rowdy's adoption is finalized and he officially becomes a Robertson. Jase gets his first massage and enjoys it more than he expected.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: After Willie and Jase lose Si's tea cup, Si makes them go to great lengths to find it. When the entertainment for Gus's 1st birthday party falls through, Jep fills in as a magician.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Dance Dads
programme.desc: Willie, Korie, Jase and Missy take dance lessons from Sadie to prepare for Reed and Rebecca's upcoming weddings. Jase's plan to perform Reed's wedding ceremony may fall through when he waits until the last minute to renew his ordainment.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: End of an Era
programme.desc: When Si decides to retire to pursue a music career, the family organizes a party in his honor. Meanwhile, Willie, Phil, and Jase take a road trip to try to recreate an old duck call for Si's retirement gift.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Looking Back and Talking Quack
programme.desc: The Robertson family takes a look back at 130 episodes of Duck Dynasty.

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner
programme.desc: Three incredible stories about the untapped power of the human brain: A Los Angeles woman's paranormal vision leads detectives to a murder victim a California man remembers every single moment of every day of his life and, a woman visits a faith healer who miraculously cures her chronic pain.

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner
programme.desc: Three mysterious freaks of nature: On the East Coast of Canada, a small community is devastated by an earth-shattering 'boom' swallowing ships and planes, a paranormal fog haunts Lake Michigan and, a blinding double flash of light over the Indian Ocean sends a nation into panic.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: Digging into a UFO crash caught on camera in Brazil a close encounter of the Beatles kind finding out if aliens shut down a nuclear missile launch site in Montana looking at the shapes of UFOs and considering a link between ghosts and aliens.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: Accounts of an amphibious UFO in Indonesia a mass abduction in Australia a slew of deaths in Wales after a strange sighting searching for an alien library with an astronaut and meeting a scientist hunting for an interdimensional portal.

programme.title: Sasquatch Unearthed: Mountain State Monsters: The Hunter Becomes the Hunted
programme.desc: Deep in the darkened forests of West Virginia, a legend roams tracked by investigators like Russ Jones, Bigfoot has long been primarily thought to roam the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Alien Files Reopened
programme.desc: Thousands claim to see a massive triangular craft hovering over Belgium in the late 80s and early 90s.

programme.title: Alien Files Reopened
programme.sub-title: Rendlesham Forest, Back from the Future
programme.desc: In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, lands near crucial NATO bases a group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with colored lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una vejación de Juju, una furia furibunda y una frente con gotelé
programme.desc: Amador y Fermín acuden al bingo con la idea de ganar dinero fácil. Allí conocen a Sonsoles, una aficionada que tiene buena suerte en el juego. La alcaldesa se muda a casa de Enrique tras su ruptura sentimental con el ministro de Interior. Los Recio adquieren un sofá en un polígono industrial y se topan con una organización mafiosa dedicada al tráfico de mujeres, Berta es confundida con una de ellas. Judith empieza a trabajar en un piso de reinserción de presos.

programme.desc: En una iniciativa sin precedentes, el alcalde de la localidad decide celebrar las fiestas patronales en el solar situado frente a Mirador de Montepinar. La gran afluencia de personas y el elevado nivel de ruido suscitan las quejas de los vecinos, que manifiestan su malestar a Enrique Pastor.

programme.desc: Mauricio organiza una fiesta temática en el bar y conoce a la atractiva Laila, pero cuando descubre que no está disfrazada, la rechaza. programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) comienza a trabajar como vendedora de cosméticos con una amiga. Cuando comienzan a tener problemas trabajando juntas, deciden trabajar por separado, lo que desencadenará en una fuerte competencia. Luisma (Paco León) monta un negocio de trileros, pero ni él ni su socio son conscientes de que este juego suele tener truco y no sólo se basa en la suerte, así que intervendrá Jonathan (David Castillo). Mauricio (Mariano Peña) se aprovecha de Chema (Pepe Viyuela) con las tareas domésticas y comienzan a surgir los primeros problemas de convivencia.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) consigue un trabajo como limpiadora en el colegio de sus hijos. Cuando las amigas Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) comienzan a ridiculizar a la limpiadora, ella no se inmuta para que no descubran que es su madre y Aída decide darle un escarmiento Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) y Luisma (Paco León) deciden que es hora de que Chema (Pepe Viyuela) encuentre pareja, así que recurren a una agencia de contactos. Toni Colmenero (Secun de la Rosa) visita a su hermano Mauricio (Mariano Peña), quien siempre le repudió por ser homosexual. Un malentendido hace que Mauricio cambie de actitud con su hermano

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Soraya esta agotada, no puede con todo el trabajo en el Reinols y acaba sufriendo un ataque de ansiedad. El psicólogo le dice que su problema está en que se esfuerza mucho por agradar a todo el mundo y que su terapia empieza por decir a todo el mundo lo que realmente piensa. Simón va a llevar a Paz de viaje en autocaravana para que la chica se olvide de Luisma. Sólo tienen un problema, ninguno de los dos sabe conducir. Macu se ofrece a acompañarles como chófer.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un lupanar, un par de suegras y una profanación
programme.desc: Antonio está obsesionado con cobrar la deuda del moroso por lo que decide investigar el entorno del propietario del 2º C con la ayuda de Enrique Pastor.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un aerofóbico, un mayorista transformista y una funeraria lowcost
programme.desc: Enrique Pastor, harto de las presiones de los lobbies, crea su propio partido político, el ACDC: Acción Ciudadana por la Democracia y la Cultura. Con el apoyo incondicional de Araceli y el eslogan 'Si tú no vas, ellos vuelven', se enfrenta a su excompañero Cristóbal en la campaña por la alcaldía. Entretanto, Antonio descubre el sorprendente mundo del transformismo mientras intenta empatizar con su hija Alba. Bruno tiene que viajar a Los Ángeles para dar un concierto benéfico, pero tiene pánico a volar, así que le pide a Judith que le acompañe. En tierra, Yolanda descubre el talento creativo de los hijos de Amador, lo que despierta los celos de Maite. Y Fermín monta una funeraria de bajo coste aprovechando la nueva ubicación del cementerio municipal.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una secesión, una sub-piña y superchochete contra el capitán Salami
programme.desc: Un nuevo paciente acaparará la atención y el interés de Judith. Gonzalo, un apuesto viudo, requerirá sus servicios como terapeuta para que le ayude a sobrellevar la trágica muerte de su esposa. Por otra parte, Teodoro encuentra en un armario el disfraz del capitán Salami de su hermano. El menor de los Rivas propone a Amador crear una webserie para narrar sus aventuras y triunfar así en el entorno online. Entretanto, Raluka Petrescu, la exmujer de Fermín, regresa a Mirador de Montepinar, donde dará una inesperada sorpresa al padre de Lola. Consciente de que la labor presidencial de su padre está siendo un desastre, Javi recomienda a Vicente y Fermín que contraten los servicios de un administrador de fincas. Sin embargo, las rigurosas medidas anti-morosidad que implementa el nuevo gestor originan un grave conflicto entre los vecinos

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un exilio rural,un exorcismo químico y la revolución de los payasos justicieros
programme.desc: La expropiación parece inevitable, así que, desesperados, Coque y Enrique deciden dejar sus viviendas y mudarse a Peñafría, un municipio que regala casas a los nuevos pobladores. Por su parte, Recio está pletórico tras descubrir que el movimiento de los payasos justicieros está calando en la sociedad, llevando a muchos seguidores a alterar el orden público en las calles. Además, Fermín lucha por recuperar a Berta, no sabe que su amada toma medicación para regular su hiperactividad sexual.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una fuga playera, un santuario para mayoristas y el retorno del detective león
programme.desc: Prófugo de la justicia, Recio se presenta en Peñafría buscando refugio, mientras Enrique, Coque y Chusa disfrutan de una vida apacible en el municipio soriano. Por otra parte, Amador decide retomar su oficio como 'detective león' para localizar el paradero del moroso. Además, Berta y Fermín detallan su plan de fuga para llevar una nueva vida juntos en la Costa del Sol.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una resistencia heroica, una catarsis subterránea y un hasta siempre
programme.desc: Ante la inminente expropiación, Recio, autoproclamado líder del movimiento vecinal, comandará la resistencia que contará con el apoyo popular de grupos espontáneos de payasos justicieros. Además, Berta tendrá que decidir si huye a la playa con Fermín o se queda junto a su marido. Mientras, Fina consigue escapar de su cautiverio en el búnker nuclear. Por otra parte, Irene y Maite descubren el doble juego de Amador y el Cuqui, atemorizado por la idea de quedarse solo, se plantea acabar con su vida.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un mayorista entretenido, un descerebrado arrepentido y una proteína de primera
programme.desc: Agustín empieza una relación. Óscar se cruza con su ex y complica lo suyo con Yoli. Berta usa a una becaria para distraer a Antonio y Greta idea un plan para equilibrar sus infidelidades con Esteban.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un libro guarro, una loba herida y un pifostio medieval
programme.desc: En el último episodio de la temporada, Antonio y Berta ultiman los preparativos para su boda medieval. Su hijo regresa para asistir... pero ahora es su hija. Mientras, Fermín contrata como becario al chef David Muñoz para revitalizar la cocina del Max & Henry. Además, Maite logra que una editorial publique su novela erótica y Enrique recibe la visita de su terapeuta, Cecilio, que viene a comprobar personalmente cómo lleva Enrique lo de aprender a vivir solo. Cuando le encuentra conviviendo con tres mujeres, se siente fracasado.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un bogavante de oro, un agente secreto y...
programme.desc: Nominado al premio Bogavante de oro, el galardón más prestigioso del sector del pescado congelado, Antonio Recio se queda sin la preciada estatuilla. La visión de su rival con el premio desata la ira del mayorista, que decide poner en marcha un infalible plan de venganza. Obsesionado con vivir un tórrido romance, Amador seduce a Violeta (Silvia Abril, ''Spanish Movie''), la enajenada e irracional hermana de Antonio, con quien pasa la noche. Lo que en principio parece una breve aventura, acaba convirtiéndose en una verdadera pesadilla cuando el Cuqui descubre que la desequilibrada joven está locamente enamorada de él. Han encadenado una larga sucesión de fracasos amorosos mientras tratan de encontrar al hombre ideal. Profundamente desencantadas con el universo masculino, Raquel y Judith deciden encauzar su vida sentimental hacia el lesbianismo y comienzan a salir juntas.

programme.sub-title: Bajo el peso de la ley
programme.desc: Tras quemar el coche de un profesor, Jonathan (David Castillo) corre el riesgo de ingresar en un reformatorio. Para evitarlo, Aida (Carmen Machi) acude a un conocido de Paz (Melanie Olivares) que es abogado, pero esto no solucionará sus problemas Luisma (Paco León) es condenado a ir a la cárcel por un delito que cometió hace seis años, cuando aún era drogadicto y ahora tiene que demostrar que ha cambiado para conseguir el indulto. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) se implica en el caso para conseguir el indulto y recoge firmas de vecinos. Con este panorama, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso), no quiere presentarse en público así que decide no salir de casa y no deja de encargarle recados a su nieta Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa). Mauricio (Mariano Peña) quiere impresionar a una chica en su cita, así que decide cambiar de imagen, para lo que acude a Fidel (Eduardo Casanova), todo un defensor del estilismo.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Chema (Pepe Viyuela) y Mauricio (Mariano Peña) deciden hacer un calendario erótico con los vecinos del barrio. Chema quiere destinar los beneficios a fines benéficos y Mauricio, para publicidad para el bar Reinols. Aída (Carmen Machi) decide intentar aspirar a un trabajo más cualificado para conseguir pagar la multa de su hijo Jonathan (David Castillo) y evitar así su ingreso en el reformatorio. Luisma (Paco León) rompe sin querer las gafas de su madre, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso), así que Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) aprovecha la ocasión para chantajear a su tío e intentar no suspender matemáticas

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) ha empezado a salir con un chico de color y Aída (Carmen Machi) se opone en rotundo a esta relación dejando ver su tendencia xenófoba a pesar de que dice que su disconformidad es por lo delincuente que es el chico. Paz (Melanie Olivares) se plantea aceptar la propuesta de matrimonio de uno de sus clientes. Con la oposición del hijo del cliente, dicha cuestión acaba siendo un debate en el que participa todo el vecindario. Luisma (Paco León) decide montar un negocio de salchichas que le hace la competencia al bar Reinols de Mauricio (Mariano Peña).

programme.title: Aída
programme.sub-title: Con balas y a lo loco
programme.desc: Mecos ha hecho un agujero en el baño para poder espiar a las chicas, él y Jonathan se disponen a probar su visor cuando son descubiertos por una sargento. Mecos escapa, pero Jonathan no y tiene que intentar hacerse pasar por mujer para que no le descubran. Paz está decidida a contarle a su hermano que está enamorada de Luisma, aunque no la apoye. Doña Hortensia, la madre de Macu, anuncia que irá a Madrid de visita. Mauricio pretende que Macu se haga pasar por una jovencita bien educada y clásica, pero ella no está muy de acuerdo. Para completar el engaño ante su hermana, Mauricio cree que debe buscarle un novio falso a Macu, un novio acorde a ella y el elegido es Fidel...

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una sonámbula, un hombre florero y un ácaro en chándal
programme.desc: Después de que Enrique Pastor abandonase la presidencia de Mirador de Montepinar y ante la falta de gestión de la comunidad, se realizan elecciones por sorteo del nuevo mandatario; así es como Vicente, de 65 años, se convierte en el nuevo presidente. Los problemas económicos de Mariscos Recio, los conflictos que genera Amador como "hombre florero" o la relación entre Fina y sus vecinos serán algunas de las tramas de este episodio.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un anabolicachas, un radar giratorio y una deconstrucción de croqueta
programme.desc: Judith mantendrá una apasionada y tórrida aventura con el apuesto entrenador del gimnasio al que acaba de apuntarse (Octavi Pujades). Mientras, su exmarido, Enrique Pastor, se verá obligado a abordar una espinosa cuestión en el inicio de su legislatura como nuevo alcalde del municipio: el uso de radares con fines recaudatorios. Por su parte, tras ser expulsado del Ático B, Fermín se traslada al apartamento de Vicente para iniciar una nueva vida en común. Sin embargo, las continuas discusiones entre los consuegros amenazan la convivencia. Al mismo tiempo, Amador pone en marcha un arriesgado plan con el que pretende recuperar a sus hijos y ganarse el afecto de su exmujer.

programme.title: El Pueblo
programme.desc: Tras años de sequía amorosa, El Ovejas se verá inmerso en una vorágine sentimental y en el epicentro de un triángulo amoroso. El detonante de esta situación será la presencia de Habiba, una joven marroquí recién llegada a Peñafría para trabajar en el hotel rural y por la que el pastor se sentirá irremediablemente atraído, convirtiéndose en una seria amenaza para los ambiciosos planes de Juanjo. Por otra parte, consciente de que la anexión conlleva un gran peligro y pocas ventajas para los peñafrienses, Cándido trata de convencer a sus convecinos de que no hay ninguna necesidad de unirse a San Pedro. Para reforzar su argumento, lleva a cabo un golpe de efecto, inaugurando la nueva piscina municipal. Entretanto, Juanjo informa a Amaya sobre el negocio que tiene entre manos para evitar que ella lo deje plantado nuevamente. Desesperado por reconquistar a su mujer, Arsacio toma buena nota de los consejos de Gus para seducirla, esperando que surtan el defecto deseado. Ruth, por su parte, trata de mitigar el estrés laboral de Laura desbloqueándole un chakra, mientras Martín acepta hacerse cargo de la elaboración del menú de la boda de Nacho y Balbina. Asimismo, Carla comienza a impartir clases a los niños y enseñarles un punto de vista diferente sobre su sexualidad, una iniciativa que podría desatar un cisma ideológico en el pueblo.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Setenta y cinco primaveras, un disconfort vaginal y el talento de Míster Rivas
programme.desc: Victoria Rafaela Balmaseda de Unzeta y Téllez-Girón quiere celebrar su cumpleaños por todo lo alto y un golpe del destino hará que Bruno sea su principal aliado en la organización de los festejos de su aniversario. Además, Antonio recibe una llamada de un compañero de prisión en la que le pide ayuda para que se ocupe de su suegra.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una tómbola gay, un hijo predilecto y una comatos
programme.desc: Tras convertirse en millonario, Teodoro (Ernesto Sevilla) pide a su hermano Amador y a su padre Ramón (Ángel Jodrá) que le acompañen a Villazarcillo, su pueblo natal, donde va a ser nombrado hijo predilecto. Sin embargo, el patriarca de los Rivas tiene reservada una sorpresa inesperada para sus vástagos. Por su parte, Óscar Serra planea pedir a Yoli que se case con él y hacerle entrega del espectacular anillo de compromiso. Sin embargo, la situación se complica cuando Vero, la novia del fotógrafo, ve la sortija antes que la propia Yoli. Impedir que la marquesa Victoria Rafaela inhabilite a su hermana y les desahucie de la pescadería será la principal prioridad de Antonio Recio, quien encuentra una la solución al problema: despertar del coma a Noelia, la benjamina de las Balmaseda de Unzeta y Téllez-Girón. Mientras, Fermín aprovecha la ausencia de Bruno con motivo de su viaje a las Malvinas, para alquilar su piso a diversos turistas que llegan a la ciudad para disfrutar de las fiestas del Orgullo LGTBIQ+. Entretanto, Logi echa las cartas a Menchu y la ilusiona tras informarle de la inminente llegada de un amor otoñal a su vida. Además, Julia continúa desafiando a sus padres haciendo gala de una aparente radicalidad religiosa, en el marco de un estudiado plan que ha puesto en marcha.

programme.title: El cuarto pasajero
programme.desc: Alberto San Juan ("El otro lado de la cama"), Blanca Suarez ("El bar"), Ernesto Alterio ("Perfectos desconocidos") y Rubén Cortada ("El Príncipe") comparten coche en esta desternillante y salvaje 'road movie' dirigida por Alex de la Iglesia. San Juan interpreta a Julián, un divorciado de 50 años, que comparte su coche con desconocidos y, en especial, con alguien que ya no lo es tanto: Lorena, una joven que viaja a menudo a Madrid. Desde hace meses tiene un asiento fijo en su coche y últimamente también en su corazón. Julián quiere aprovechar el viaje para sincerarse con ella, pero en un error a la hora de escoger al resto de los ocupantes incluye a un pasajero -el individuo más insoportable del mundo- que provocara¿ un cambio radical en el rumbo de los acontecimientos. Con guion del propio De la Iglesia y de su colaborador habitual, Jorge Guerricaechevarría, "El cuarto pasajero" es una comedia negra romántica llena de giros inesperados, acción, mucho ritmo y romanticismo impregnada, en todo momento, por el particular sello de su director.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Okupas, flechazos y golpe en el garaje
programme.desc: Despechada al conocer que el atractivo actor no desea saber nada de ella, Raquel comunica a los vecinos que no les arreglará los desperfectos. programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: When a popular New Jersey high school cheerleader is abducted and found stabbed to death in a water retention tank, the case takes an unexpected turn when another young woman is found murdered ten days later.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: When the brutal killing of a young woman in her home spawns numerous other horrific murders in the quiet suburb of Elkridge, Maryland, investigators look into strange appearances of brutalised mannequins in the area.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: After a multi-millionaire’s wife passes away and he finds new love through a younger woman he meets at a private club, they end up marrying, and also adopt her younger twin daughters in order to have the perfect family unit.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: In the small rural town of Fayette, Maine, Ted Flagg returns to his newly purchased home to find his wife Judith stabbed to death. Investigators struggle to find suspects and the case is left unanswered for the next 23 years.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: In the small town of Ozark, Alabama, Tracy Harris’ body is found strangled to death and dumped in the local river. With the obvious suspect being her abusive ex-husband, investigators struggle to link him to the murder and the case goes cold.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder

programme.title: Imperfect Murder

programme.desc: When a likeable aspiring model leaves her office job to pick up her son from her ex-husband, with whom she shares custody, she goes missing and is discovered dismembered in a nearby lake.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop New York
programme.desc: Host Nina Parker and the cast look back at the big moments from the season, check in with Mendeecees and endeavor to withstand more than a few chaotic moments on the stage.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop New York
programme.desc: Nina Parker tries to keep the order as more cast members decide to get physical with each other, Drewski has a surprise for Sky, and Yandy has to answer some tough questions.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop New York
programme.desc: Papoose helps Remy Ma manage her comeback, Yandy and Mendeecees receive bad news, and Amina tries to stick out her rocky love triangle with Peter and Tara.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop New York
programme.desc: Cardi B calls out DJ Self, Amina confronts Tara, tensions brew between Rah Ali and Moe, and Rich's teenage daughter Ashley moves in.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop New York
programme.desc: Amina makes a shocking revelation, Cardi B drops a bomb on DJ Self's girlfriend Yorma, Mendeecees has a tough conversation with his son, and Moe goes behind Rah Ali's back.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: From prehistoric predator to modern king, track the lion's epic rise. Science reveals fierce battles, tight bonds and the brutal tactics behind Africa's most iconic hunter.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: Biologist and animal-tracking expert Lizzie Daly gets acquainted with the newly collared female jaguar, which they’re calling Aroeira, as the Onçafari research team works on habituating the new cat to their presence. Meanwhile, the pre-programmed hour is drawing near for Lizzie’s tag to drop from Badalo’s collar — but where? With Badalo moving deeper into the flooded forest, there’s a good chance it will end up underwater. The data Lizzie’s tag is collecting could be a game changer for jaguar research and conservation, but it’s all for naught if she can’t recover it.

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
programme.desc: In South Africa’s Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters: the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she’s got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who’s honing her survival skills in Brazil’s Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: From prehistoric predator to modern king, track the lion's epic rise. Science reveals fierce battles, tight bonds and the brutal tactics behind Africa's most iconic hunter.

programme.title: Wild Dogs - Pack vs. Pride
programme.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP’s lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms
programme.desc: Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimp’s pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness’ flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters’ club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant’s secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Marvel at the little fish that keep sharks' teeth clean, discover dolphin families' signature calls, watch capuchin monkeys crack nuts with stone tools, and meet a meerkat mobster.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Footage from extreme habitats around the world reveals how rapid changes are taking place on Earth, and emphasis is placed on how animals react to such extremes, including humpback whales, tiny butterflies and chimpanzees.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Islands are like miniature simplified Earths, where evolution is playing out at superspeed right before our eyes. We journey from the Galapagos to the edge of Antarctica to seek out animals responding in extraordinary ways to our changing planet. We find sealions hunting in a completely new way, lizards changing shape because of hurricanes, and monkeys eating charcoal in response to deforestation.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: In the hottest extremes, species are going to extraordinary lengths to survive. From the Sahara Desert to the Australian outback, animals are providing new clues about our changing planet and what it will mean for the future of our heating world. Chimps are living in caves, camels are drinking salt water and zebra finches are singing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Heading to the most remote and frozen ends of the Earth, we find that the poles are changing faster than anywhere else on the planet, a warming world in fast-forward. Tracking the shifts in the movement and behaviour of the animals that live here, from polar bears in the Arctic, to penguins in Antarctica, can reveal detailed changes and give us vital information about our future world.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Once overlooked, we now know that grasslands have a hidden power. Not only can they host the greatest gatherings of life on Earth, but they could even heal our planet. Key species, from the wildebeest of the Serengeti to the bison of the North American prairies, can revive forgotten habitats. Healthy grasslands could be more resilient carbon sinks than forests, and even slowing climate change.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Pridelands - Wilderness Reborn
programme.desc: The inspirational story of family who left the Sydney suburbs to transform a derelict farm and former hunting ranch in South Africa into a sanctuary for local wildlife.

programme.title: Big Cats - Nine Lives
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride - males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.desc: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poacher's snare. Meanwhile, the center's resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors - a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A wise, old leopard reigns over the Luangwa Valley in Zambia. She holds her own against lions, but is about to face her most serious challenge: the arrival of a younger, nomadic female leopard. Witness the bitter battle of experience versus vitality.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Chipazua is no ordinary leopardess. She relies on her mother Malaika for food, although she should be an independent adolescent by now. When Malaika tires of her behavior and wanders off, Chip faces a harsh new reality. She now must hunt for herself, evade danger, and even navigate courtship with a local male leopard. But can she acquire the necessary skills at this late stage of her life?

programme.title: Snow Leopards With Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards With Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast
programme.desc: Max prowls through the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.desc: Governments around the world may be using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Time Travel
programme.desc: Evidence suggests that time travel may have occurred in the past.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Nazis Today
programme.desc: For decades, there have been rumours key members of Hitler’s inner circle escaped the fall of Berlin - maybe even the Führer himself. But where did they go and what is their plan?

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Rise Of The Machines
programme.desc: If technology goes too far, too fast, a time may come when humans are no longer at the top of the evolutionary food chain.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: America's Alien Wars
programme.desc: Has our government been at war with alien aggressors for the past half century? Startling evidence indicates that the US military has been under attack and has kept it from the public.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Secret Alien Attack
programme.desc: Secret satellites. Death stars. The weaponisation of outer space. Are governments the world over preparing for an alien attack? And if so, why are we being kept in the dark?

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Freaks of Nature
programme.desc: A yacht vanishes on Lake Michigan and mysterious lights over the Indian Ocean send a nation into panic.

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Life After Death
programme.desc: An emotional visit to a Civil War battlefield and a series of bizarre circumstances lead a Connecticut man to believe he is the reincarnation of a dead general. In Haiti, a man dies after a mysterious illness but returns from the grave 20 years later!

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Medical Mysteries
programme.desc: A skydiver who survived after falling more than 11,000 feet on to tarmac, and debating whether humans can spontaneously combust.

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Parallel Worlds
programme.desc: An explorer finds a crystal skull in Mexico, believing it holds the key to another universe, and the bizarre machine that could uncover the secrets of teleportation.

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Power of the Mind
programme.desc: A housewife who believes a psychic vision helped her solve a murder, and a man who remembers every moment of his life with pinpoint accuracy. Plus, a healer who claims to cure diseases through prayer

programme.title: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Alien Encounters
programme.desc: Strange events suggest that aliens are among us. In Colorado, a farmer discovers a cow mutilated by unknown forces, a Texas man is repeatedly abducted from his bed, and in Ohio, an astronomer's powerful telescope intercepts a mysterious message.

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 167
programme.desc: Did Adolf Hitler survive Operation Valkyrie only because he was in a conference room instead of an underground bunker? Can you literally knock some sense into a person by slapping them?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 207
programme.desc: Can you share the task of driving, change places while driving or push the driver out while moving at regular speed? Can you prevent cats from defecating in your garden?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 128
programme.desc: Could a skydiver whose parachute failed to open hit a playground seesaw and send a small girl flying seven stories high...and she could still survive?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 169
programme.desc: Can a combination of footwear and technique allow a person to run on water? Can a person survive an explosion by hiding behind a table, a car, a dumpster or a cinderblock wall?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 19
programme.desc: Myths tested: Can mirrors be used to make a death ray? What solutions are effective against skunk smell? Which common objects are bulletproof?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 116
programme.desc: Are two interlaced phone books impossible to pull apart? Can a shark be blown up like it was in "Deep Blue Sea?"

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 29
programme.desc: Myths tested: Can a person escape from prison using salsa? Can hardened cement be removed from a cement truck using explosives?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 211
programme.desc: Will a crab pot drag you overboard if your foot is caught in a coil? Is it better to work a 30-hour grind with no sleep than with a 20-minute nap every 6 hours?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 209
programme.desc: Can concentrated hydrofluoric acid in a bathtub completely dissolve a human body, create a hole through the tub and dissolve the bathroom floor below it?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 33
programme.desc: Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen and subsequently make the woman pregnant?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 224
programme.desc: Can watering plants with microwaved water kill them? Can you put out a fire on a lake by turning a boat at an angle? Can metronomes started at different times sync together?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 223
programme.desc: Do males prefer women with blonde hair? Do pheromone sprays work? Are women attracted to wealthy men? Do men give larger tips to women with larger breasts?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 174
programme.desc: Can wheel spikes and a hood-mounted machine gun be used to disable a pursuing vehicle? Can a bullet spin in place after being fired onto the surface of a frozen lake?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 213
programme.desc: If a single car brakes lightly, can it cause a ripple that triggers a major traffic jam? Is it better to stay in one lane in heavy traffic instead of changing lanes?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 178
programme.desc: Can a swimmer increase his chances of surviving an underwater explosion by floating at the surface? Did armies in ancient China use paper armor that was as effective as steel?

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Un perro se comió mi tarea / El fin
programme.desc: Dunglap contrata a Perro para que coma su tarea, así realmente puede decir la excusa de que mi perro se comió la tarea. / Perro y Gato se convencen de que una gran nube negra se aproxima y es el fin del mundo.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: ¡Extra, Extra! / Perro y Gato al cuadrado
programme.desc: Perro y Gato se hace cargo de una ruta de reparto de periódicos en el vecindario después de que Perro persigue al repartidor de periódicos, nuevamente, y él renuncia. / Perro y Gato conoce a Dan Stan, otro Perro y Gato.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: El secreto de Kike / Show de monstruos
programme.desc: Perro y Gato descubren que Cliff, está asistiendo a clases de ballet. /Randolph reúne a Gato y Perro en el circo. Perro y Gato se presentan al público, pero nadie los aplaude.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: En el centro comercial, Perro y Gato se sientan sobre el regazo de Santa cuando una malcriada niña (la sobrina de Rancio el Conejo) anuncia que quiere a Perro y Gato como regalo de Navidad.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Perro y Gato logran conseguir un nuevo trabajo como Perro Bombero en el departamento de bomberos de Nearburg. / Perro entra al espectáculo de perros de Nearburg y se disfraza como un afgano peludo con corte de cabello.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Noche de Sumo / Hotel Gato y Perro
programme.desc: El hambriento Perro y Gato comen una tonelada de comida en Rib Room, se ponen muy obesos y desafortunadamente no pueden pagar la cuenta de un muy altísimo costo. / Perro y Gato convierten su casa en un hotel de lujo para ganar dinero.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Shriek sobre hielo / No, gracias por los recuerdos
programme.desc: Shriek decide renunciar a los Grasosos y cumplir su sueño de ser campeón de patinaje sobre hielo. / Perro se golpea en la cabeza mientras persigue el camión de la basura y le da amnesia.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Perro y Gato en el rodeo / Dientes para dos
programme.desc: Mientras pasean por la Feria Estatal, Perro y Gato se encuentran montando sobre un feroz toro. / El odontólogo Rancio el Conejo descubre que cualquier cosa que Perro coma, afecta a los dientes de Gato y viceversa.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: A pesar de las objeciones de Gato, Perro arrastra a Gato al Parque Temático para subirse a Butt Buster, una montaña rusa que va a 200 millas por hora. / El Alcalde Rancio necesita más fondos para su tina de monedas de oro.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Silencio, por favor / Mis sueños del gorila
programme.desc: Perro y Gato en bancarrota, bailan en la calle, pintan retratos de las personas y venden una manzana podrida a Cliff, el perro Grasoso. / Aparece un gorila en la casa de Perro y Gato justo cuando estaban saliendo al bowling.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Dulce y Lola / Shriek rico, Shriek pobre
programme.desc: Perro y Gato están descansando en el jardín cuando se encuentran con Lola Caricola, que se muda al árbol que tienen en el jardín. / Perro y Gato trabajan como empresa de catering en una lujosa fiesta en una mansión de Nearburg.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: El automóvil de Perro y Gato se rompe y se ven obligados de llevarlo al taller de Lube. / Perro encuentra la vieja cámara de Gato y pasea por todo Nearburg tomando fotografías de personas en situaciones vergonzosas.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Perro y Gato de dobles de riesgo / Los groseros en la neblina
programme.desc: Perro y Gato se tropiezan con un plató de cine, y se convierten en dobles. / Perro y Gato convencen a Lola de infiltrarse entre los Grasosos para conocer sus hábitos y encontrar sus debilidades.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Doo Wop / Documental de Perro y Gato
programme.desc: Tito se tropieza con los perros Groseros en la calle cantando Doo Wop. Los reúne con Perro y Gato y forman un grupo de canto para convertirse en súper estrellas. / Lola Caricola tiene que hacer un documental sobre Gato y Perro.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Nearburg se convierte en tierra invernal y Perro y Gato, Lola, Dunglap, Mervis y los perros Grasosos aprovechan la oportunidad para pasear en trineo por la nieve. / Perro obtiene un equipo de hipnosis de juguete.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Camión de monstruos / El oro de Perro y Gato
programme.desc: Perro construye su propio Camión de Monstruos y arrastra a Gato hasta la plaza de Nearburg para participar del Rally de camiones de monstruos. / Lola convence a Perro y Gato de producir miel en el jardín.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Caramelo de Perro y Gato / En movimiento
programme.desc: Perro y Gato pelean durante el almuerzo y continúan en la cocina, tiran harina, azúcar, chocolate y frutas por todo el lugar. / Perro y Gato heredan algunas tierras en la costa del hermoso lago Wanamaker, empacan sus cosas y se van.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Gato nuevo en la ciudad / Perro y Gato Cousteau
programme.desc: Nearburg se siente atormentado por el gigante gato que les recuerda al monstruo Gatozilla de la película. / Perro y Gato van hacia la Caleta de Nearburg para encontrar el tesoro que se hundió con el pirata Barba Naranja.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Cuidado con Cliff / Perro y Gato lazarillos
programme.desc: Después de un accidente golpeando hierro, Cliff cambia y se convierte en un perro nuevo, promete dejar de hacer cosas malas. / Perro y Gato se convierten en el perro lazarillo para el ciego multimillonario TJ Wolfington.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Perro y Gato se transportan al año 3001 para luchar contra el malvado Gran Tito. / Lola vence a Gato por primera vez en la Convención de Inventos de Nearburg y lo que convierte a Gato en un enemigo envidioso.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Walt, el pavo del desfile de Acción de Gracias, aparece en la casa de Perro y Gato buscando refugio. Perro lo hace entrar y el hambriento Gato lo quiere devorar.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Es la noche de Halloween y Gato, se disfraza como Duque Kahanamoku de Hawai y Perro, se disfraza como Conde Perrdrácula, salen en busca de dulces. Un vampiro peruano, Nosferacho, muerde a Perro y lo convierte en vampiro.

programme.title: CatDog

programme.desc: Perro está entusiasmado porque hoy es el Día de Bromas Raras, la versión del Día de los Inocentes. / Perro y Gato se preparan para volver al reencuentro de la vieja escuela, en donde Gato quiere reavivar su romance con Sally.

programme.desc: Es el Día Anual de los Padres y, como siempre, Gato y Perro quedan excluidos porque no tienen padres. Perro espera que este año sus padres finalmente aparezcan. Gato insiste en que la búsqueda es en vano.

programme.sub-title: Rebecca's Special Attack! Last-Ditch Sword Dance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Big Surprise! The True Identity of the Toy Soldier!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Horrible Past! The Secret of Dressrosa!
programme.desc: Bartolomeo finally finds Luffy and starts to lead him to Zoro, while the toy soldier begins to tell the heart-breaking story of how Doflamingo cheated the Riku dynasty out of their control of Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night of Dressrosa!
programme.desc: As the toy soldier's story continues, the sad fate of King Riku and his army, and his daughter Princess Viola, is revealed as well as how the people of Dressrosa fell into the hands of Doflamingo. And all the toys in the country share a mysterious secret.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
programme.desc: Zoro, Kin'emon, and Luffy are reunited again, but little do they know that their reunion is being monitored by a potential threat! Meanwhile, the battle rages on between Doflamingo and Law as these two powerhouses clash.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
programme.desc: Zoro and Kin'emon make a mad dash to save Law but Navy Admiral Fujitora stands in their way, bringing his full power against them. The Navy is in hot pursuit as a ship approaches with unexpected visitors from the past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherits Ace's Will!
programme.desc: After revealing the horrible history of Dressrosa, Toy Soldier now shares their plan to liberate the Tontatta Kingdom and bring down the Doflamingo Family, Operation SOP. Luffy bumps into a heavily-wounded Bellamy and Bartolomeo

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Operation SOP Starts! Usoland Charges Forth!
programme.desc: Usopp and Robin make their way via an underground tunnel dug by the tiny people of the Tontatta Tribe - a tunnel so small in fact, that Franky couldn't fit! Instead, Franky makes his way to the Toy House.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
programme.desc: As the contenders for the battle of Block D dwindle to only thirty, Rebecca has her hands full with the menacing Suleiman the Beheader! All hope seems lost that she can take him down and move on to the finals!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The End of the Match?! A Surprising Result of Block D!
programme.desc: The battle for Block D comes to a shocking end and the winner that emerges from the cloud of dust stuns the audience even more! Meanwhile, Luffy, Zoro, Kin'emon, and Wicka of the Tontatta Tribe are about to reach the lift to the palace.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
